title: Fury
description: On the way to see his sweetheart (Sylvia Sidney) a man (Spencer Tracy) is wrongly jailed and besieged by a lynch mob.

title: And Then There Were None
description: An unknown host (Barry Fitzgerald) brings 10 sinners to an island, for punishment one by one.

title: Murder, She Said
description: Agatha Christie's sleuth Miss Marple (Margaret Rutherford) gets a job at an estate where she thinks there's a corpse.

title: The Kennel Murder Case
description: Detective Philo Vance sifts through clues and comes up with seven possible suspects in the murder of a sportsman.

title: Suspicion
description: Alfred Hitchcock directs a thriller about a woman who thinks that her husband is plotting to murder her.

title: The Case of the Curious Bride
description: San Francisco lawyer and gourmet chef Perry Mason (Warren William) solves a murder at a cocktail party.

title: The Case of the Howling Dog
description: Lawyer Perry Mason (Warren William) shows the jury the truth about three murders stemming from a marital mix-up.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: River's End
description: A fugitive (Charles Bickford) assumes the identity and love life of a look-alike Mountie dead in a blizzard.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
description: Court followers foil a plot by having a British look-alike (Ronald Colman) pose as the king of Ruritania.

title: The Scarlet Pimpernel
description: London dandy Sir Percy (Leslie Howard) dons disguises to save French nobles from the Reign of Terror guillotine.

title: The Glass Slipper
description: Mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, scullery maid Ella (Leslie Caron) finally meets her prince (Michael Wilding).

title: When in Rome
description: A priest (Van Johnson) on a pilgrimage tours Roman cathedrals with an escaped convict (Paul Douglas) posing as a priest.

title: You Can't Fool Your Wife
description: An outcast husband (James Ellison) flirts with another woman who turns out to be his wife (Lucille Ball).

title: Quality Street
description: A British spinster (Katharine Hepburn) poses as her niece to woo an ex-suitor (Franchot Tone) back from the Napoleonic wars.

title: The Guardsman
description: An Austrian actor suspicious of his wife's loyalty decides to test her by posing as a charming military officer.

title: Hero at Large
description: An actor (John Ritter) costumed as Captain Avenger foils a grocery-store robbery and becomes a sensation.

title: Matinee
description: A producer (John Goodman) sells his new monster movie with gimmicks in Key West, Fla., during the 1962 Cuban missile crisis.

title: The 'Burbs
description: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.

title: The Howling
description: A shaken TV newswoman (Dee Wallace) finds a doctor's (Patrick Macnee) retreat crawling with werewolves.

title: Eyes of a Stranger
description: A TV newswoman (Lauren Tewes) catches a pervert (John DiSanti) watching her sister (Jennifer Jason Leigh) who cannot see, hear or speak.

title: The First Deadly Sin
description: A New York police detective with a bedridden wife hunts a killer who uses a mountaineer's ice ax.

title: Jupiter's Darling
description: Roman general Fabius sends his swimming bride (Esther Williams) to stall an invasion by Hannibal (Howard Keel) and his elephants.

title: The Last Days of Pompeii
description: A blacksmith (Preston Foster) becomes a gladiator and Pontius Pilate's (Basil Rathbone) partner, then sees Vesuvius erupt and finds Christ.

title: Caesar and Cleopatra
description: The aging Caesar finds himself intrigued by the young Egyptian queen. Adapted by George Bernard Shaw from his own play.

title: Julius Caesar
description: Shakespeare's Brutus (James Mason), Cassius (John Gielgud) and others plot the Roman ruler's death, but Mark Antony (Marlon Brando) avenges it.

title: Barabbas
description: A thief is spared from crucifixion and tries to comprehend the man sent to die in his place.

title: Spartacus
description: A gladiator slave (Kirk Douglas) leads a revolt in decadent Rome and attempts to lead his followers to freedom.

title: They Shoot Horses, Don't They?
description: Desperate people (Jane Fonda, Michael Sarrazin, Susannah York) enter a grueling dance marathon in Depression-era Chicago.

title: Lifeboat
description: A chic writer (Tallulah Bankhead), a stoker (William Bendix) and others drift with the U-boat captain (Walter Slezak) who has sunk their ship.

title: The Blob
description: Formless red slime lands in Pennsylvania and engulfs people; teens (Steven McQueen, Aneta Corseaut) try to warn scoffing adults.

title: Fiend Without a Face
description: A scientist's (Marshall Thompson) atomic-powered thoughts materialize as deadly flying brains with trailing spinal cords.

title: The Thing From Another World
description: Arctic soldiers and scientists find an alien aircraft containing a frozen creature (James Arness) that wakes and feeds on human blood.

title: Them!
description: Bug experts (Edmund Gwenn, Joan Weldon), a state trooper (James Whitmore) and an FBI agent track giant mutant ants from New Mexico to Los Angeles.

title: First Man Into Space
description: A commander's (Marshall Thompson) astronaut brother (Bill Edwards) returns slime-covered and the host for an alien bloodsucker.

title: Jour de Fete
description: A French mailman (Jacques Tati) sees a film on U.S. postal efficiency and applies it to his route on Bastille Day.

title: Monsieur Hulot's Holiday
description: A hapless French tourist attempts to make the most of his disastrous vacation as he causes havoc at a seaside resort hotel.

title: Mon Oncle
description: Simple bachelor M. Hulot charms his nephew in his brother-in-law's gadget-filled home.

title: Flamingo Road
description: A small-town Florida sheriff (Sydney Greenstreet) frames his political pawn's (Zachary Scott) dancer girlfriend (Joan Crawford) for prostitution.

title: A Lion Is in the Streets
description: A Southern salesman (James Cagney) marries a schoolteacher (Barbara Hale) and runs for governor as a champion of sharecroppers.

title: A Face in the Crowd
description: A TV woman (Patricia Neal) turns Arkansas bum Lonesome Rhodes (Andy Griffith) into a homespun media hero rotten with power.

title: Patterns
description: A New York corporate boss (Everett Sloane) grooms an Ohio engineer (Van Heflin) for the No. 2 man's (Ed Begley) job.

title: Boorman and the Devil
description: Filmmaker John Boorman seizes the opportunity to direct "Exorcist II: The Heretic," but the movie's disappointing reception from critics and fans nearly ends his career. Includes interviews with Boorman and actresses Linda Blair and Louise Fletcher.

title: Exorcist II: The Heretic
description: Four years after an exorcism, another priest (Richard Burton) arrives to free a possessed young woman (Linda Blair).

title: Hope and Glory
description: A 9-year-old boy (Sebastian Rice Edwards) recalls life with his mother (Sarah Miles) and family in World War II England.

title: Point Blank
description: A ruthless crook seeks revenge against the partner who betrayed him and left him for dead on Alcatraz Island.

title: In My Country
description: An American reporter (Samuel L. Jackson) and an Afrikaans poet (Juliette Binoche) meet and fall in love while covering South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission hearings.

title: Microscopic Mysteries
description: The life and death struggles of insects are viewed through a microscope.

title: The Green Slime
description: Two space-station astronauts (Robert Horton, Richard Jaeckel) destroy an asteroid, then face monsters formed from viscous cells.
